#### Legendary Mai Tai A Tradition Since 1954

Welcome to Bahi Hut, Florida’s oldest tiki bar and a cherished Sarasota landmark since the town's earliest days. Immerse yourself in our midcentury ambiance, complete with vintage Polynesian décor and a spirit that’s remained unchanged for generations. Enjoy our legendary Mai Tai, made the same way for decades — when you’ve perfected paradise, there’s no need to reinvent it. And if you still have the old Bahi Hut jingle stuck in your head from those radio days, don’t worry—you’re not alone. Come see why Bahi Hut has been capturing hearts and taste buds for years.

- Always the lowest rate.
- Complimentary cocktail at check-in.
- Hassle free changes to your booking.
- You get a real live person, no automated machines!

What's unique?

- Great central location for Sarasota & the beaches without the crowded downtown. 
- Fully renovated in 2022!
- Oldest tiki bar (Bahi Hut) in Florida is on-site! 
- Huge 50' outdoor heated swimming pool.

###### Relaxation & adventure is just a Mai Tai away.

Escape to a tropical oasis at our renovated 1950's resort, where mid-century modern meets island paradise. Our 50-foot heated saltwater pool is the perfect spot to soak up the sun, while our on-site Tiki Bar, the legendary Bahi Hut, serves up the best Mai Tais in all of Florida.

TIKI BAR (ON-SITE) 

AMENITIES 

VENUE RENTAL 

Old Florida meets modern amenities

Our rooms are adorned with vintage decor, including atomic-inspired lamps and bold patterns, creating an ambiance that is both nostalgic and chic. Relax in style in our comfortable and spacious accommodations, complete with modern amenities such as free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs. 

Whether you're looking for a romantic escape or a fun-filled family vacation, our resort has everything you need.

Lounge by the pool, sip on a Mai Tai, and indulge in the laid-back island lifestyle. Explore the nearby beaches, enjoy water sports, or take a stroll through the charming historic district.

Come and experience the magic of our tropical paradise, where the past meets the present, and relaxation and adventure are just a Mai Tai away. Book your stay now and let the good times roll at our mid-century modern resort.

### What are the standard check-in and check-out times? 

Check-in starts at 3:00 PM and check-out is at 11:00 AM! Let us know if you need anything else.

### Can I request a late check-out?

We can usually extend your stay until 12:00 PM! Just text us on the morning of your check-out to confirm we have the availability.

### Is early check-in available? 

Yes! Early check-in is $20 per hour up to 3:00 PM. Just text us on your way in and we’ll do our best to get your room ready!

### Can I store my luggage at the front desk?

You sure can! Feel free to drop your bags at the front desk if you arrive early or want to explore after check-out.

### How do I return my room keys when leaving? 

Just leave your key cards on the desk in your room and text us back that you're heading out. Safe travels!

### How do I use the lockbox for an after-hours arrival? 

We’ll text you a special code and instructions for the lockbox right before you arrive so you can grab your keys easily!

# Diner & Drinks

We have a mixture of indoor & outdoor arrangement, covered from the rain and sun but plenty of tropical vibes. You'll have music, an entire legendary bar & it's team for your guests the whole time. Options to have a caterer for full service or buffet tables. Whichever experience you want, we have the team & contacts to help me get there. 

# The Ceremony

If you love the Florida outdoors but want to keep your ceremony private, we have the perfect space for you. The pool area can accommodate anything up to 350 guests but be intimate enough even for 20 guests. You have the options of the various pool lawn spaces, pool deck, or the Bahi Hut patio. 

# The Celebration

Everyone has a Bahi Hut story, it's time to make a new one. The drinks and the party are what make us legendary. Whether you're hosting the entire celebration with us or just the party, we have multiple spaces for you to choose from.

# OUR LOCAL RECOMMENDATIONS

Here are our favorite local restaurants based on personal staff & guest experiences.

Map View

## BREAKFAST - SUNNYSIDE CAFE

(walking distance)This location is a breakfast favorite for locals. They're walking distance from the resort & have a lot of options for everyone!

Google Map

## BREAKFAST HOUSE

(6 minutes - downtown) The chef is the owner & she has won multiple awards. Her pancakes came in 1st place in a state-wide competition recently. We highly recommend them. Easy access & parking.

Google Map

## PHILLIPI CREEK OYSTER BAR

(20 minutes South - on the water)This is a local favorite. Delicious American style fresh seafood with a beautiful creek view. They have outdoor & indoor seating.

Google Maps

## ANNA MARIA OYSTER BAR

(8 minutes North - shopping mall area)This local chain has a couple locations. They have fresh seafood at great prices. If you're craving fresh oysters, this is the place to go. The Anna Maria Island location has great outdoor dock-side seating.

Google Maps

## WICKED CANTINA

(3 minutes - towards downtown SRQ)Modern Mexican & American food with quality food and drinks. Whether you want a quick bite after a long journey or a change from our own Tiki Bar on site, Wicked Cantina is a great choice. One of our favorite lunch spots.

Google Maps

## SELVA

(5 minutes - downtown SRQ)Peruvian derived with a modern setting with great food. You'll typically need reservations though. They have indoor & outdoor seating. Great choice to celebrate or have a date night. Their steaks are excellent.

Google Maps

## SPICE STATION

(4 minutes downtown SRQ)One of our favorites for lunch & diner. This Thai restaurant has a lot of great dishes. They use quality ingredients and a very reasonably price. They're in a sort of plaza which makes their outdoor seating very inviting.

Google Map
